## YT-DLP Command Builder 1.1.0

- Added Frame mode to save one PNG frame from Instagram video at the selected time.
- Frame commands use the selected yt-dlp engine and cookies, and forward the matching stream headers and cookies to FFmpeg.
- Refreshed the AMOLED launcher icon.
- Updated to Android version 1.1.0 (version code 11).

Android 10 or newer. This app only generates commands. It does not download or query Instagram content. Signed with the existing release identity.
